description: This file defines a helper class 'ValidationDecorator' that provides methods to modify validation rules for parameters in an API validation context. It interacts with classes such as 'ParamRule', 'Rule', and constants in 'Rules' to configure validation logic like 'required' and 'not required' rules with options to exclude empty strings.

classes.name: ValidationDecorator
classes.description: A helper class providing methods to decorate and modify parameter validation rules by setting required and optional rules with specific configurations.

methods.name: requiredParamRule
methods.description: Configures a ParamRule object to enforce that the parameter is required, with an option to exclude empty string values.

methods.name: notRequiredParamRule
methods.description: Configures a ParamRule object to specify that the parameter is not required, with an option to consider or exclude empty strings during validation.
